assumptions.statement: The gateway membership set is fixed, finite, complete, and known to the collector.
assumptions.role: Defines the coordinates that must be covered before closure.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: Dynamic membership and omitted configured gateways are outside the theorem.

assumptions.statement: Capabilities form an acyclic single-parent lineage and legal descendants monotonically attenuate authority and expiry.
assumptions.role: Makes ancestor exclusion dominate all legal descendants.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: Arbitrary policy graphs and multiple-parent joins are not covered.

assumptions.statement: Grant, revoke, and receipt records have authentic origin, canonical encoding, and intact signer-domain separation.
assumptions.role: Prevents forged coverage and forged lineage edges.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: Production key custody, transport authentication, and compromised issuers are not evaluated.

assumptions.statement: Gateways are honest and may crash, recover, or be disconnected; they are not Byzantine.
assumptions.role: Lets a receipt attest to the gateway's actual durable exclusion transition.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: Byzantine gateways and malicious storage are out of scope.

assumptions.statement: A receipt is issued only after a durable exclusion transition commits, and committed exclusion survives process recovery.
assumptions.role: Makes receipt coverage stable after closure.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: Physical power-cut and disk-corruption guarantees are not inferred from process-crash evidence.

assumptions.statement: All active gateway and collector clocks are nonnegative and within one fixed error bound of nondecreasing real time, including after recovery.
assumptions.role: Upper time excludes actual expiry; retained lower time certifies expiry; d <= epsilon is permanently unusable under the nonnegative-clock authorizer.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: A clock reading outside the stated bound cannot cover a coordinate.

assumptions.statement: Compaction preserves a persistent admission floor sufficient to reject replayed records below the retained boundary; the Delta-specialized metadata bound applies only while the latest successful compaction age is at most Delta.
assumptions.role: Prevents old grants and revokes from re-entering after metadata deletion.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: Arbitrary lossy compaction is not covered.

assumptions.statement: Each gateway serializes authorization-changing transitions through the declared SQLite transaction boundary.
assumptions.role: Prevents half-committed grant, revoke, floor, and in-memory state.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: The artifact does not claim lock-free progress or high-load linearizability.

assumptions.statement: The collector commits monotone evidence before returning completion and reopens only under the same immutable target, audience and error bound.
assumptions.role: Makes returned completion monotone across valid observation updates and non-rollback recovery.
assumptions.removed_or_out_of_scope: A stale snapshot, changed membership, changed clock bound, or untrusted database modification is outside the claim.
